subject: Important Update: Your Recent Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We wanted to inform you that there has been a change in your upcoming flight itinerary. Your departure time has been rescheduled to accommodate airport maintenance. Please review the updated details in your booking confirmation email. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
